remarks: Charming Cape Cod style home nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac in the heart of Cos Cob in Greenwich, CT. This beautifully appointed two-bedroom, one and a half bath residence features an inviting living room with a cozy fireplace, a versatile office/sunroom, and a dining room that flows seamlessly into the kitchen. Step outside to a spacious deck overlooking a picturesque, level backyard-perfect for relaxing and entertaining. Conveniently located near all that vibrant Greenwich has to offer. Don't miss this wonderful opportunity!
